entry_gate: G8 final acceptance audit and all reports/snapshots saved
question: How do frozen light adapters compare with a mature estimated-mask Souden MVDR pipeline on the same simulated conditions? Oracle diagnostics separate practical mask limitations from ideal simulator assumptions.
sources: All G5 252 cases including36 clean, and all G7 648 cases; same12 utterances3 speakers,900 per new system. Existing evaluated data, exploratory comparison, not a new held-out confirmation.
main_comparator: mcnet_mask_mvdr: accepts noisy six channels and exact saved originalMcNet mono estimate only; no target/reference/DOA metadata
oracle_diagnostics: oracle_ref_mask_mvdr supplies true clean reference as mask estimate; oracle_doa_delay_sum supplies simulator true direction at elevation10deg and nominal array. Neither is a fair blind deployed competitor or guaranteed upper bound.
numerics: CPU float64/complex128, official torchaudio.functional.psd(normalize=True,eps=1e-10), mvdr_weights_souden(reference_channel=4,diagonal_loading=True,diag_eps=1e-7,eps=1e-8), apply_beamforming. Save mono float32 FLOAT WAV, no peak normalization or signal fitting. Nonfinite/errors preserved, no metric-selected fallback.
preflight: STFT identity, identical channels/reference identity, silent covariance finite, independent plane-wave renderer validates DS delay sign with target-only SI>25dB, invalid shapes/nonfinite rejection. Save QA report/snapshot before benchmark cases.
scoring: Same SI-SDR/PESQ/STOI; both frozen Whisper tiny.en and wav2vec2 greedyCTC, existing exact-sample caches where eligible. Include G5 clean-input controls and per noise/SNR/direction, all existing adapter seeds; no new training or selection.
timing: CPU beamforming wall time per case separately; main comparator also requires saved McNet estimate whose original generation time is reported. Asset/model import and I/O excluded from pure filter time; no streaming claims.
failure_policy: Keep partial files/log; abort for numerical/nonfinite failures, diagnose before rerun under a distinct revision, never silently replace with noisy audio
